apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.11 — Single playback, app-wide: starting the song from any entry point (transport, loop chip, group chip) now stops a playing swara phrase and the other studios. The loop and group chips used to start the song engine directly, so a playing phrase sounded over the song. Also carries v1.5.10 (editor Cancel button).
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
